alive.last_commit_message:
feat(skill-scan): add per-scan token and prefix-cache accounting (#823)

Adds thread-safe cumulative LLM token accounting to skill-scan, split out from #817 to keep low-risk observability independent from the audit-guardrail changes.

- `skill_scan/utils/llm.py`: lazy-initialized counters (calls, prompt_tokens, cached_tokens, uncached_prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, usage_missing_calls) with `get_usage_stats()` / `reset_usage_stats()`, preserving compatibility with `object.__new__(LLM)` test doubles.
- `skill_scan/agent/agent.py`: snapshots usage across `self.llm` and `self.specialized_llms` around `Agent.scan()` and exposes `result["token_usage"]` plus INFO logging. Scan prompts, tool calls, and verdicts are unchanged.
- `pytests/test_token_accounting.py`: offline unit tests for accumulation, cached/uncached breakdown, missing-usage payloads, reset, and `Agent.scan()` reporting.

Local verification on PR head b070cc39:
- `pytest pytests/ -q` → 244 passed (no regression)
- `ruff check` on the three files clean; no Go packages touched
- CI: Build and test Go packages + GITHUB_OPENSOURCE_SCAN_PIPELINE both success; mergeable_state clean

Co-authored-by: kentzjh-cmd <kentzjh-cmd@users.noreply.github.com>
